A '''Command Group''' was a temporary unit assembled by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Sector Command (Alliance)/Legends|Sector Command]] to take command of critical operations within a [[Sector/Legends|sector]].
